title: Host has seen Jacobs' DD214

tellings.quote: By the way, I've seen Bob Jacobs' DD214. He definitely worked at Vandenberg.

plain: Michels says he has seen the DD214, the US military's discharge record, of Bob Jacobs, a man whose account of a 1964 Atlas rocket launch at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California is said to have been scrubbed from the records. Michels says this himself, as someone who looked at the paper: it shows, he says, that Jacobs "definitely worked at Vandenberg." The point is that Jacobs was where he says he was when the launch took place.
